title: wg: targeted-messages-01 L466 The privacy analysis covers only the sender
description:
draft-ietf-mls-targeted-messages (targeted-messages-01), 8.5 Sender Identity Confidentiality. Editors' copy mlswg/mls-targeted-messages at ae3ab52, L466.

Text: "Sender
identity is therefore protected from the Delivery Service and from entities
outside the group, but not from other group members who obtain the encrypted
message."

Problem: The privacy analysis covers only the sender. recipient_leaf_index is sent in the clear, so a Delivery Service that knows the ratchet tree learns who each targeted message is for and the per-pair traffic pattern. Published -01 has the same gap.

Suggested fix: Add a sentence saying the recipient's leaf index is visible to the Delivery Service, that with the ratchet tree it reveals the recipient's identity, and that padding and cover traffic are the only mitigations.

Severity: low. Verifier: keep (recipient_leaf_index, group_id and epoch are cleartext fields of TargetedMessage (lines 80-87). Section 8.5 discusses only sender confidentiality. The point is real and the fix is one sentence.)

From MLS audit workflow wf_581e61f8-b25 (2026-10-21). Not yet reviewed by Mark; nothing posted upstream.
